mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The primary difference between custom and semi-custom kitchen cabinets lies in their flexibility and cost. Semi-custom cabinets come in a wider range of sizes, finishes, and door styles than stock cabinets, offering more personalization options, but they are built to standard dimensions with limited modifications. Custom cabinets, on the other hand, are entirely built to order, offering unlimited choices in size, shape, material, finish, and design. This allows for precise fit in unique spaces and highly specialized storage solutions. While custom cabinets are a greater investment, they provide unparalleled design freedom and quality, making them ideal for specific architectural challenges or unique visions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Semi-custom cabinets offer more options than stock but are standard sizes; custom cabinets are built to exact specifications for unlimited design and fit, though at a higher cost.
